title: Framed Chess
tagline: Single player tiktaktoe wagers using base, onchainkit, transaction frames, custom contract
description: We're launching an innovative approach to playing Tic-Tac-Toe on the blockchain, seamlessly merging it with L2 network capabilities for an improved viewing experience. Participants will have the chance to mint their own Tic-Tac-Toe grids as NFTs, partake in matches, and 'broadcast' these games live through the L2 network. This framework allows for a single player to kick off a game, whilst providing the opportunity for an infinite number of spectators to observe the game in action directly on the L2 network.
how_its_made: We are crafting an engaging blockchain-based single-player Tic-Tac-Toe game that utilizes the L2 network for gameplay dynamics and broadcasting. The initiative encompasses the creation of interactive Tic-Tac-Toe grids, the development of game logic, and integration with the L2 network to enable on-chain recording of game moves. Upon deployment, an individual player will start a game, with the feature for an unlimited audience to observe the gameplay live. This setup ensures that every move made on the Tic-Tac-Toe board is transparent, secure, and verifiable, offering a unique gaming experience that combines classic entertainment with cutting-edge blockchain technology.
